method: Independent raw-source, inventory, compiler-log, declaration and axiom-output reconciliation; no imports of gate parser or runner

execution_environment_check.review: The existing adapter remaps only the current process numeric /proc/PID/exe readlink to /proc/self/exe. The runner preserves inherited LD_PRELOAD and uses TMPDIR for temporary directories; no Lean kernel or proof source was edited.

limitations: This uses the same pinned Lean kernel and precompiled Mathlib, not a second kernel or fresh Mathlib build.
Negative controls check their stated false extensions, not all possible theorem edits.
Reconstructed new chart sources have new current hashes; byte identity with lost unpublished sources is not asserted.
